must: Preparation properties: purpose, process scope, organisational scope, detail, flexibility, obligation, philosophy, application area, environment, method neutrality.
Selection: organisation then project; **Why → What → How**.
**Boehm & Turner**: size, criticality, dynamism, personnel, culture (agile vs plan-driven).
**Tailoring** = delete / modify / add; also in agile. Criteria: team, internal env, external env, objectives.
Process QA: achieve goals consistently **and** performed as defined (audits). Governance ⊃ IT governance ⊃ process governance; compliance = yes/no; **COBIT**.
traps: Tailoring isn't only for plan-driven processes.
Deployment fails without the **reward/reaction** step — ignoring non-conformance signals it doesn't matter.
likely: Apply Boehm & Turner to recommend agile or plan-driven.
Write a Scrum product backlog for the TNG eWallet case.
tricks: Boehm & Turner = **'Small, Calm, Changing, Clever, Cool → agile'** (size, criticality, dynamism, personnel, culture).

story.problem: A process must fit each project and actually be followed, not just written.
story.fix: Define, select, tailor (Boehm & Turner), deploy (state–enable–verify–reward) and assure it with audits.
